tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngan song sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi rnam par bshad pa gzhung don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭ+ṭa ka gu ru dharmā swa mi bha ga wan bai ro tsa na ye na maḥ bod skad du/ rje btsun bla ma chos kyi rje bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi spyod pa nyams su len pa la/ spyi'i don dang / gzhung gi don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal la dgongs nas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs kyang / bsdu na theg pa chen po dang / chung ngu gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir theg pa chen po'i nyams len zhig ston pa yin/ de la yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i nyams len zhig ston pa yin/ de la yang gang zag so so'i 'dod pas/ rgyud sde gsum du 'dod pa/ bzhir 'dod pa/ lngar 'dod pa/ drug tu 'dod pa la sogs pa bshad srol bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang / slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i sngags don rnam gzigs las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye pas/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang gsum las/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / legs grub kyi rgyud dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud dang / bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams yin cing / rgyas par ni rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bya rgyud spyi rnam du blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud ni/

rnam snang mngon byang dang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud dang / phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs rnams yin cing / rgyas par ni rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i spyi rgyud rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni/ slob dpon lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka' ba/ /bshad rgyud cha mthun rgyud kyis gsal bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud dang / cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum las/ dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud ni/ de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud de/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang / phyi ma'i phyi ma ste 'di gsum la lha gnas gsum pa zhes grags so/ /gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud ni/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud dang / rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa rnams yin no/ /gsum pa cha mthun pa'i rgyud ni/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dang / rab gnas mdor bsdus kyi rgyud dang / yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu'i rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs pa rnams yin no/ /'o na rnal 'byor rgyud 'di la rgya gar du bshad srol ji ltar byung zhe na/ tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po zhes grags so/ /de gsum gyi slob brgyud paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / lo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyis gsan nas bod du dar bar mdzad do/ /de'i dus kyi lo chen gyi slob ma ni bo dong gi spang kha 'dar ston/ dbye dge 'byung / nyang smad kyi mkhas pa lce zhar/ nyang stod kyi rkyang po chos blo/ rin spungs kyi gsum ston ye 'bar/ rong g.yag sde'i gnyan ston tshul khrims 'bar/ rong pa chos mgon/ rong pa 'gar dge /lce blo ldan seng ge la sogs pa nas/

bu ston rin po che'i bar gyis dar bar mdzad do/ /lugs 'di ni lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la gsungs kyang sa cha smad du dar bas na yo ga smad lugs zhes grags so/ /lugs 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba'i lugs te/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'di phyag len dang dbang bka' kun snying ltar mdzad kyang / bshad pa shākya bshes gnyen ltar mdzad pas phyag len dang bshad pa mi mthun zhes grags so/ /de'i dus su mnga' ris stod du bon po dar nas 'jig rten pa rnams mos par gyur pa la/ de 'dul phyir dang / de'i dus su lo chen yang sku na gzhon pa dang / lo chung yang gre ngag snyan pa la brten nas yo ga la dbyangs kyi 'dren pa mang du mdzad cing / spros pa yang shin tu che bar mdzad do/ /'o na yo ga smad lugs 'di bla ma sa skya pa la bka' srol bzhugs sam zhe na bzhugs te/ lo chen gyis lo chung la/ des dbus pa dge ser la/ des bla ma gnam kha'u pa la/ des bla ma sa skya pa la gdams so/ /yang lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la dang / shar+dha ka ra warma gnyis mnga' ris stod du phebs dus/ lo chen gyis rnal 'byor rgyud la sogs pa'i gdams pa gsan cing / khyad par sbyong rgyud rtsa rkyang gi bshad pa 'di gsan no/ /paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la 'di phyag len dang bshad pa slob dpon kun snying gi lugs la shin tu mkhas shing 'di dang brgyud thag kyang nye ba yin no/ /paṇ+ḍi ta 'di ni sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la/ rdor dbyings la sogs pa'i yo ga chen mo rnams kyi rgyas mi 'gebs par/ sbyong rgyud kyi dbu zhabs bsdebs te/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas cho ga rnams tshang bar mdzad do/ /spros pa chung zhing phyag len shin tu gtsang ba yin no/ /de'i dus su lo chen sku na bgres pa dang / bon po 'dul ba'i spros pa yang bshol nas lugs 'di la shin tu thugs mnyes nas phyin chad phyag len 'di la mdzad do/

/de'i dus kyi lo chen gyi slob ma ni/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ skyi steng pa dz+nyā na shrī/ go rib rin chen bsod nams/ gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i stod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis thos bsam gyi sgo nas gtan la phab ste dar bar mdzad do/ /'di ni lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la gsungs kyang sa cha stod du dar bas na stod lugs zhes grags pa yin no/ /ding sang phyag len yang 'di la mdzad do/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ shākya thub pa nas rim bzhin du brgyud de paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la/ des jo bo rin chen bzang po/ des brang steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ des mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ des bla ma sa skya pa kun dga' snying po la/ des rje btsun sku mched nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa yin no/ /yang lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la/ nag tshos jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod du spyan drangs te mnga' ris stod du phebs pa la/ lo chen gyis tho ling gser gyi lha khang du spyan drangs te 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang du gsan cing / de'i dus su go mi sgom chen gyis kyang rnal 'byor rgyud la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du gsan cing / khyad par sbyong rgyud rtsa rkyang gi bshad pa 'di gsan no/ /de'i dus kyi go mi'i slob ma ni/ skyi thang dz+nyā na shrī/ snyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur pa nyi ma 'od zer/ des rtsa skya pa la/ des 'dzim pa la gdams so/ /lugs 'di ni yo ga stod lugs dang yang shin tu mthun pa yin no/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba bod kyi gangs blta ba yin zer mnga' ris stod du phebs pa la/ lo chen gyis sbyong rgyud zhus/ man ngag mchan du btab pa/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mchan sna bsrings pa dkyus su shor ba 'bru 'grel rgan po zhes pa zhig yod la/ de'i bshad bka' yang sa skya pa la bzhugs so/

/des spyi don mdor bsdus pa song nas/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis/ sbyong rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs spyir bstan pa dang / brtag pa dang po kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos btags ma phye ba'i dbang du byas na/ dkyil 'khor bcu bdun te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ste bcu gnyis/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bcu drug ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor dang bcu bdun no/ /dang po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ni/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los bsgyur ba yon tan kyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor dang drug 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ni/ phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ klu chen brgyad kyisྎ 'jigs byed dgusྎ gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor dang drug go /yang dngos btags phye na zhe gcig tu 'gyur te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te so drug las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bzhi bcu/ ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor dang zhe gcig tu yang 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan 'od zer gyi phyag len gyi rim pa rnams/

rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi nang du bkod pa ltar nyams su len par byed pa la/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba rten dang mchod pa bshams pa ni/ rang gi gnas sam/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gnas shin tu yangs par phyag dar dang / rkyang nul legs par byas pa'i sar/ bla bre dang yol ba bkram la/ ras la sogs gzhi bzang po'i steng du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor zhal 'jig rten pa'i shar du phyogs par bkram/ de'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor mchod yon gnyis pa/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri mchog byang du zhal zas rnams phul lo/ /spyi mchod de'i phyi rol tu/ rgyas par na spos/ mar me/ lha bshos gsum tshan pa re re byas pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa bsham/ bsdu na spos mar me lha bshos gsum tshan pa re rer gyes pa phyogs bzhir bco lnga bco lnga bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su lho nub nas shar lho'i bar gtso bo'i zhal 'gros dang mthun par phyogs skyong 'byung po'i gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis 'theb kyus brgyan pa/ rigs drug dang yi dwags la zan ril bcu tshan gnyis/ bgegs la 'theb kyu gnyis ltag sprad de'i steng du 'theb kyu gcig bslangs nas bzhag pa ni/ sa steng sa 'og sa bla gsum gyi bgegs la ster ba yin gsungs/ yi dam gyi gtor ma ni sbyong rgyud nas ma bshad pas mi mdzad do/ /de ltar gtor ma lnga tshar du bshams pa phyag len no/ /de las gzhan pa'i yo byad ni/ til nag gu gul nag po/ bye nag yungs kar/ khrus ras/ khrus long / gos zung la sogs pa'i 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'tshogs par bsham mo/ /rnal 'byor pa so so'i mdun du stegs bu'i steng du/ rang gi g.yas su rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu'i mtshal zhal rdo rje'i lte ba la bstan te bzhag

gzhan yang rnga dang / dung dang / sil snyan la sogs pa'i rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang 'tshogs par bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun te/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa/ phyi rol tu phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la sogs pa rnams la gtor ma btang ba/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ bdag dang gtso bo tha mi dad du bsgrubs te brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba/ gshin don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa la drug ste/ thog mar mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlab pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ lha grub pa'i rgyu gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ grub nas gzhan don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sgrub dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i sgo khang gi nang du zhugs par bsam pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ mchod pa la gnod sbyin gyi bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam mo/ /rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya de las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas mchod pa'i ma dag pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsam mo/ /bsang sbyangs gnyis ka'i sngags dang phyag rgya brtag pa dang po las gsungs so/ /swa bha wa ni bla ma kha cig bzhed kyang dngos su ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang rung gsungs/ mchod pa'i snod bcud gnyis ka oṃ las bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon kun snying gis rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel bar gsungs so/ /de yang oṃ ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi sa bon yin la/ nam mkha' mdzod las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas so/

/zhes gsungs/ ngag 'don ni/ oṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi rang sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya rnams ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las 'byung ngo / /dharmā ra ṇi'i rol sngags kyang rnam snang sgyu drwa'i 'grel par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shāka thub las/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs dag la/ /thos nas yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i lam med cing / /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /ces pas bstan/ ngag 'don ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba zhes pa nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni brtag pa dang po las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs 'gyur ba/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por brjod/ /ces pas ston/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag 'don ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi rnam snang sgyu drwa'i 'grel par gsungs pa'i chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la zhes sogs te/ 'god par bya zhes pa yan gyis smon pa sems bskyed bstan/ de'i dge 'dun nas bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan/ 'di lan gsum byed pa ni sems bskyed kyi cho ga yin pas shin tu legs gsungs/ gsum pa ni brtag pa dang po las/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan/ de la yang rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma'i man ngag rdo rje 'byung ba nas kha bskangs pa ste/ de la yang drug thog mar sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ rigs kyi khro bo bsgom pa/ de la dbang bskur zhing go bgo ba/ sngar yod kyi bgegs tshar gcod pa'i phyir bsnun bsreg bcings gsum bya ba/ phyin chad mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/

de brtan par bya ba'i phyir las kha tshar ba bya ba'o/ /thog mar sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i/ dang po yid byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dang po stong nyid bsam nas ni/ /lus can kun gyi dri ma bkru/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngag 'don ni/ oṃ swa bha wa/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa'i bar te/ de'i don bsgom pa ni/ yid ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ngag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtsug dgu las/ rdo rje'i lce ru rab bsam pas/ /sngags zlos mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang skad cig gis zhes pa nas/ dzi ha zhes pa'i bar te/ ngag 'don dang bsam bya dkyus bzhin du bsgom pa ni/ ngag sngags bzlas pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa lus byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi zhes pa nas/ rtse gcig par gyur/ ces pa'i bar ni/ lus phyag rgya 'cha' ba la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rigs kyi khro bo bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ gsod dang skrod pa'i las rnams la/ /sngags pa'i khro bo nga nyid de/ /me ltar 'bar ba zhes bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ngag 'don ni/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba zhes pa nas/ zhugs par gyur ces pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa dbang bskur zhing go bgo ba ni/ khro bo ti rin ta'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ bam̐/ zhes brjod pas khro bo'i nga rgyal bzung la phyag rgya de nyid spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs shing / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐/ zhes brjod pas/ gnas de rnams su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ra gdengs pa gyen du langs pa re re'i rtsa ba rdo rje sngon po chu brgyugs kyis bcings par bsam/ go bgo ba ni/ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang pa/ dkyus su khru nyi shu rtsa gcig gnas/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /snying kha nu ma'i bar dang ni/

/snying kha mgrin pa rgyab dpral ba/ /dgur mdud pa bcings la/ rna ltag gnyis su 'gu gu chung la/ lhag ma lus tshad dang mnyam par bsam zhing / oṃ trum̐/ oṃ badz+ra tu khe ho/ zhes brjod cing / thal mo rtse sprad la bsham pa gdab bo/ /bzhi pa bsnun bsreg bcings gsum ni/ rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ badz+ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ rdo rje de las de 'dra ba'i me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bsnun par bsam/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya de las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam/ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ni tri sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya de las ye shes kyi srad bu kha dog sna lnga pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bcings par bsam mo/ /lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ ḍi ḍo'i sngags rgyas 'og phyogs rab bcings te/ /'jigs byed steng dang gnod sbyin steng gi 'og /gtsug tor shar dang zhags pas shar gyi nang / /ba dan nub dang nag po'i sngags rgyas byang / /rtse mo'i sngags rgyas lho phyogs bcings bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje bsdams pa kha phub pa brkyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍo sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas phung brdal ba ltar bsam mo/ /'jigs byed kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ hu lu sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ steng du rdo rje gur gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ gur de'i 'og tu de dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i gur gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ druṃ sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ shar du gur steng ma dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam/ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ hūm̐ sogs brjod pa'i tshe/

shar gyi de'i nang du gur nang ma dang mnyam pa'i ra ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam/ rdo rje ba dan gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṃ sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ nub du gur 'og ma dang mnyam pa'i rwa ba gru bzhi gcig grub par bsam/ rdo rje nag mo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hri badz+ra ka li sogs brjod pas/ byang du gur 'og ma dang mnyam pa'i ra ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /khyad par rdo rje'i char yang phab par bsam mo/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ shī sogs brjod pas/ lhor gur 'og ma dang mnyam pa'i ra ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /de yang steng dang shar gnyis lan gnyis 'ching ba ni/ mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud las/ tshangs pa brgya byin mthu che bas/ /shar dang steng gnyis lan gnyis bcings/ /zhes gsungs/ lho rjes la 'ching ba ni/ gshin rje'i bu mo chu len ma zhes bya ba 'gros shin tu bul bas lho rjes la 'ching ba yin gsungs/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ hūm̐ badz+ra karma zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ de dag thams cad kyi phyi rol tu sna tshogs rdo rje 'bum brtsigs su byas pa'i ra ba gru bzhi pa gcig bsam/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ sogs brjod pas de'i nang du rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po gcig grub par bsam mo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa snying khar dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha bam̐ zhes brjod pas/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur grub par bsam mo/ /drug pa las kha tshar ba la brgyad de/ khro bo spyan drangs pa/ de la gdan dbul zhing mchod bstod bya ba/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba/ bdag bsrung ba/ gnas bsrung ba/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba/ sems dpa' tha ma bzhi'i bsrung ba/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas brtan par bsam pa'o/ /dang po khro bo spyan drangs pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad ni mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa sogs nas gshegs su gsol gyi spyan drangs/

pad+ma ka ma las gdan dbul/ ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa sogs nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs kyis bstod/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po sogs nas/ gdon mi za zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bdag bsrung ba ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ snying kha/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su reg cing / sum+bha ni sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ snying kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ dpral bar rin po che ser po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyis rgyas gdab par bsam mo/ /gnas bsrung ba ni/ sngar gyi sngags rgya de nyid phyogs mtshams rnams su bstan pas/ sngar gyi srung 'khor de dag gsal gdab cing brtan par bsam pa'am/ yang na cho ga'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung bar bsam gsungs/ sems dpa' tha ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas kyang sngar gyis srung 'khor brtan par bsam zhing / yig brgya tshar gsum gyis kyang lhag chad kha bskangs shing brtan par bsam mo/ /srung 'khor rgyas pa'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ me ltar 'bar ba las/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes rang gi sku bor te/ khro bo me nyi ma zhes bya ba'i snying po nyid kyi thugs kha nas phyung ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro ta sogs kyis bstan te/ 'di'i phyag na rdo rje ni sku mdog ljang sngon yin te/ pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud las/ hūm̐ skyes phyag na rdo rje ni/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ /sku mdog ljang sngon cung zad khro/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag na bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhes pa dang mthun cing / 'di ni rgyud gsung ba po'i phyag na rdo rje dang don gcig gsungs/ ngag 'don ni bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar byas la/ de nas satwa dgu bskor gyi/ dang po gsum gyis pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya gnas gsum du reg cing / dang pos lus lha bsgom pa la dbang / lus kyi bar chad bsrung / gnyis pas ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang ba dang / ngag gi bar chad bsrung ba'o/ /gsum pas sems ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang ba dang / yid kyi bar chad bsrung ba'o/ /bar pa gsum gyi dang pos srung 'khor bskyed/ gnyis pas gsal btab/ gsum pas brtan par bsam/ tha ma gsum gyis cho ga'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bar chad bsrung bar bsam mo/ /bzhi pa lha 'grub pa'i rgyu gzugs can gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas gsal bar bstan cing / de yang rang gi lag gnyis kyi mthil du a ā zhes sogs nas/ aṃ ā zhes pa'i bar brjod pa'i g.yas kyi zla ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thabs snying rje'i chen po/ g.yon gyi zla ba ni spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab bo/ /de gnyis kyi steng gi g.yas kyi hūm̐ ni ye shes lnga dang / g.yon gyi ā ni dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'o/ /de dag rtogs par byed pa'i thabs stong nyid bcu drug ni ā li bcu drug gi rnam par shar ba'o/ /des hūm̐ la g.yas bskor dang / a la g.yon bskor bsam mo/ /g.yas kyi mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo rnams la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can la sogs pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / g.yon gyi mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo rnams la/ oṃ las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa'i yum lnga ste/ de dag thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par gsal bar bsam zhing / lha phan tshun mthong ba'i ye shes sam/ lam bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes so/ /thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las/ a no ya ni a nu ga te sarba dharma zhes brjod pa'i tshe/

lha phan tshun reg pa'i bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes so/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las/ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu tra bi tra sarba dharmā zhes brjod pas/ phan tshun snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam bzod pa'i ye shes so/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las badz+ra añtsa li a dhen ta a nu tra sarba dharmā zhes brjod pas phan tshun chu la chu bzhag pa dang / mar la mar bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du 'dres pa'i bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i ye shes so/ /phyag rgya phral te/ badz+ra ban+dha traṭa gsum brjod pas mthong spang gi dri ma dang bral bar bsam mo/ /rang gi snying kar zla ba la dang po'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang po'i rdo rje'am/ a dmar po'i rnam pa rang gi lus la char ltar babs pas/ lus dang sems la bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes par bsams zhing / dang po'i rdo rje la thim par bsam mo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bskyod cing / oṃ badz+ra a we sha a ā zhes pa bcu nas brgya'i bar brjod pas/ mthong lam gyi ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍ+ri ḍo sogs nas badz+ra mu bam̐ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod cing / snying kar rdo rje bsdams pa dkrol la se gol lan gsum gtogs pas sgom lam sa dgu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam mo/ /lnga pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa ni/ tshe dpag med las/ bdag gi de nyid dran bya zhing / /zhes dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /thams cad zos shing kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes pas lha bskyed pa bstan la/ ji ltar bskyed pa na/ yang tshe dpag med las/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/

/sems kyis bsgom par byas nas su/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsam zhing dam tshig phyag rgya dang / /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sgrub pa pos ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlabs/ /steng 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes dang / shāka thub las/ mnyam par bzhag pas dpral bar ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi thal mo sbyar/ /sangs rgyas bde gshegs bskyed rnams kyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad/ /rnal 'byor rig pas mgrin phyogs su/ /thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las/ /rtag tu pad+ma'i rigs nyid kyi/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snying khar gung mo mtha' sbyar ba/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /dam tshig thams cad 'dzin byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim bzhin du brjod na/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis ye shes tshogs sogs bstan/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam zhes pas zla gdan bstan/ de'i 'og gi pad+ma ni gleng gzhi'i skabs nas/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ zhes pas bstan to/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su zhes pas sa bon bstan la/ bsam zhing dam tshig sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa bstan cing / sgrub pa pos ni sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis sku yongs su rdzogs pa bstan te/ rdo rje'i mchog gsum bskyed bstan pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi ngag 'don ni/ oṃ swa bha wa nas/ bzhugs par gyur ces pa'i bar ro/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlabs/ /zhes pas rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ sngags ni bh+ri ta sogs kun rig las gsungs/ phyag rgya shāka thub las/

mnyam par bzhag pas dpral bar ni/ /sogs gong du bstan to/ /steng 'og ji bzhin go rim du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas dbang bskur ba bstan cing / sngags/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs phyag rdor nas gsungs so/ /phyag rgya kun rig nas 'byung ngo / /bdag bskyed bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir ye shes pa 'jug pa ma bshad pas 'jug pa yang mi mdzad/ de'i stobs kyis mjug tu gshegs gsol mi dgos pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin no/ /'bras bu lha bskyed pa'o/ /drug pa grub nas gzhan don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la lnga ste/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams ngan song nas drang ba/ de dag gis ched du brjod pas ched du brjod cing mchod bstod ji ltar bya ba/ slar yang bzlas pa'i sgo nas gzhan don ji ltar bya ba/ dngos grub blangs shing yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ba/ slar yang mchod bstod bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ tshangs pa chen po zhes pa nas/ gsol to zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ e ma ho/ zhes pa nas/ bzhag ces pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni gleng gzhi'i skabs nas gsungs so/ /bstod pa ni me ltar 'bar ba nas 'byung ba ltar/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan brgya rtsa'i sgo nas bstod pa ste/ de yang rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas mtshan bcu ni/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /sogs sh+lau ka phyed dang gnyis kyis bstan/ rdo rje rgyal po'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /sogs dang / rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje legs pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje pad+ma byang chub la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje las kyi sgo nas drug ni/ rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje bsrung ba'i sgo nas brgyad ni/ rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sgo nas dgu ni/

rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi sgo nas dgu ni/ bsgrub bka'i bsgrub pa la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ 'od stug pa ni sogs so/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sgo nas drug ni/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan sogs pa'o/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ sgra chen zhing ni la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgo nas lnga ni/ glog bzhin zhal gyi la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje chos kyi sgo nas drug ni/ spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje rnon po'i sgo nas lnga ni/ 'khyil zhing rgyan yang la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje smra ba'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba la sogs pa tshig rkang bzhi ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' ma gtogs gzhan thams cad tshigs rkang bzhi bzhis bstan te/ de ltar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag su la mnga' na/ chos brgyud sangs rgyas la mnga' ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' de la'o/ /lnga pa slar yang bzlas pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bya ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ de dag dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /brgya rtsa nyid du tshang par bzlas/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i skabs 'dir brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzla bar bya'o/ /bsgom bzlas gnyis dkyus bzhin no/ /spyir sbyong rgyud bshad pa'i skabs su/ bsnyen pa bsgrub pa las sbyor zhes pa'am/ bsnyen pa dang dkyil 'khor las rim gnyis zhes bshad pa las/ bsnyen pa'i skabs re zhig bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor las rim gyi dbang du byas pa'i bdag bskyed do/ /lnga pa dngos grub blangs shing yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba sogs kyang dkyus bzhin no/ /drug pa slar yang mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rgyud nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len no/

/gnyis pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi chus/ /rab tu bkang ste bzhag par bya/ /zhes rnam rgyal bum pa bstan la/ dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas dbang bum bstan cing / gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni/ /brgyad dam bcu drug lhag kyang rung / /zhes pas mchod bum bstan la/ las bum ni 'dir ma bshad pas mi mdzad do/ /tshe dpag med las/ mar me gtor ma bum pa dang / /zhes pa dang / kun rig las/ bya dang bum pa bskang ba dang / /zhes pa'i bum pa 'dis las bum bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ des ni nye bar mkho ba'i bum pa bstan pa yin no/ /spyir bum pa'i tshad/ mtshan nyid sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba dang 'dra la/ bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa dang / phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang du 'dod pa dang / bum nang du gzhal yas khang rdzogs par bskyed pa dang / nang gi chu dang bum rdzas rnams lha'i rgyur byas nas bskyed pa dang 'dod lugs mang du 'byung yang / rang lugs ni bum pa chu dang rdzas so so'i sum gnyis tsam gang ba'i chu'i steng du lha so so'i gdan gyi steng du lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa ste/ ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /bum rdzas ni/ dpung bzang las/ mu ge'i bskal pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /nas sran gro 'bras til dang lnga/ /'bru sna lnga yang bum par gzhug /nad kyi bskal pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /sle tres kan+dha ka ri dang / /rgya mtsho shu dag dbang po lag /sman sna lnga yang bum par blug /mtshon gyi bskal pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /mu men byu ru la sogs pa'i/ /rin chen lnga yang bum par blug /tshul khrims rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /dza ti ga pur gur gum dang / /tsan dan dkar dmar a ka ru/ /dri sna lnga yang bum par blug /kun gyi snying por gyur pas na/ /dgos 'dod thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'o ma bu ram sbrang rtsi dang /

/mar dang lañtsa la sogs pa'i/ /snying po lnga yang bum par blug /gzhan yang bum pa'i tshad/ mtshan nyid sogs rgyas par shes par 'dod na/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung gi zin bris rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa kho bos byas pa'i bum pa'i rnam bshad las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa la don bcu ste/ rten gzhan yas khang bskyed pa/ brten pa lha bskyed pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba/ de la byon legs bya zhing mchod yon dbul ba/ khrus gsol zhing gdan dbul ba/ mchod pa dbul zhing phyag 'tshal ba/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab cing las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /them skas bzhi yi phreng ba can/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i phyi ru ni/ /gling bzhi po dag bri bar bya/ /'dzam bu gling du tshangs pa bri/ /zhes pas dngos su 'jig rten pa'i khor yug bstan la/ shugs kyis dkyil 'khor sgo nyis sbrags bstan pa yin no/ /'o na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gang gis bstan na/ brtag pa dang po las/ gtso bo bris sku lugs ma'ang rung / /rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /zhes pas bstan la/ ngag don ni/ yak+ṣa nas/ gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes sogs dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun zla 'dra ba/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhes pas gtso bo bskyed pa bstan nas/ 'khor gzhan rnams ni/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni/ zhes sogs kyis bstan cing / sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje 'byung ba la sogs nas kha bskang ba'o/ /bskyed tshul ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/

oṃ sarba bid zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin no/ /ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs la/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ spyan 'dren tshul ni/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs sh+lau ka gsum po 'di/ ma ga ta bzang mo'i rtogs brjod las 'byung ngo / /zhes zer yang / sngon gyi rab gnas mkhan po zhig gis mdzad dam zhes rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsungs so/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /zhes sogs sh+lau bzhi ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi rab gnas kyi cho gar gsungs so/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥnas/ sa ma ya satwam̐ gyi bar shāka thub nas gsungs/ de la byon legs bya zhing mchod yon dbul ba yang slob dpon kun snying gis gsungs/ khrus gsol ba ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig ni/ de nyid 'dus par gsungs/ gdan dbul ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs sh+lau ka gcig ste kun snying gis gsungs/ mchod pa ni/ lha la sogs pa'i dri'i rdzas sogs sh+lau ka lnga ni legs grub kyi rgyud las gsungs so/ /phyag 'tshal ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ kā ro mi zhes pa'i bar rdo rje 'byung ba nas gsungs so/ /dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ brtag pa dang por/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /rdo rje bcings pas bcings pa nyid/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du rtse sbyar te/ /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du sbrel/ /mthe bong gnyis ni nang du gzhug /bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan te/ sngags rgya ni dkyus bzhin no/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /mdun bskyed kyi skabs 'dir dbang mi bskur bar dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par/

kun rig gi mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ dbang mi bskur bar rigs bdag rang chas can du bsgom pa'o gsungs pa la dgongs nas rje btsun gyi gzhan phan 'od zer du ma gsungs/ de'i phyir gzhan phan mtha' yas su yang ma gsungs pas mi mdzad do/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab cing las la sbyar ba ni rje btsun chen pos bka' dang bstan bcos gzhan nas bshad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs 'dir ma gsungs kyang / kho bo ni 'dir phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs yod par mngon te/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dngos su gsungs la/ chos kyi phyag rgya ni lha so so'i sngags brjod pa tsam la bshad cing / las kyi phyag rgya ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas de nyid gnyis su byas te gar byas na/ las kyi'o/ /zhes pas las rgya bstan la/ phyag rgya chen po ni shugs las 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'ang las rgya ni/ rang gi dku g.yon du rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyar la/ oṃ na mo nas/ bud+dha ya zhes pa'i bar brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis phral nas/ gnas gsum du gar bskor bya zhing / tad+ya thā nas/ swahā'i bar brjod pa gtso bo'i las rgya dang / oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa sogs ni gtso bo'i chos rgya'o/ /lte ba'i thad khar mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya 'cha' ba ni gtso bo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /gtso bo'i sku la rtog pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /se gol gtog cing / sems can thams cad ngan song nas 'don pa'i 'phrin las mdzod ces pa ni/ las la sbyar ba'o/ /nang sgeg bzhi'i dam rgya sogs de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs/ byang sems nyan rang gi dam rgya la mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti'i dkyil chog ltar/ de'ang brtag pa dang po las/ thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las/ /gung mo srin lag rtse mnyam bsgrengs/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni nang du bcug /mdzub mo gnyis ni bkug byas de/ /lcer ba byang sems spyi yi'o/

/nyan thos kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar ba/ /snying khar sbyar ba nyan thos kyi'o/ /zhes dang / rang rgyal gyi phyag rgya ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur nang bstan te/ /mdzub mo mthe bong rtse mnyam bsgrengs/ /g.yas pas mtheb srin sbyar brang sprad/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ nang sgeg bzhi'i dam rgya ma gtogs dam rgya gzhan rnams sbyongs rgyud rang nas gsungs so/ /bcu pa mchod bstod ji ltar bya ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ ar+gham̐ mchog rtag gsang la sogs pa yi/ /dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ ar+gham̐ mchog rtag ces pas nyer spyod phyi'i mchod pa bstan la/ gsang zhes pas gsang mchod bstan cing / sogs pa yi zhes pa'i sogs khong nas mchod pa nyer lnga pa bstan pa yin no/ /dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod dang zhes pas bstod pa bstan la/ lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod ces pas/ lha rdzas kyi mchog rgyal srid sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga bstan pa yin no/ /phyi mchod rgyas par byed na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma dang / stong gsum ma/ chu bo gaṅgā ma la sogs pa mdzad pa phyag len te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma ni/ de nyid 'dus par lhug par gsungs pa rkyang pho chos blos tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'o/ /stong gsum ma dang / chu bo gaṅgā ma ni/ lo chen rin bzang gis gsungs so/ /mchod pa nyer lnga pa ni/ lha'i bu nor bu dri med pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa ste/ gleng gzhi'i skabs nas 'byung ngo / gsang mchod/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad po 'di ni/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs so/ /rin chen sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs so/ /bstod pa/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces pa nas/ dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/

/zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka drug po 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ rtis gsungs/ rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhi ni sbyong rgyud rang gi dngos bstan no/ /sgeg mo phreng ba sogs sh+lau ka gnyis ni rje btsun gyis gsungs/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka bcu drug ni rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs/ rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka bcu gnyis ni smṛ rtis gsungs/ sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka lnga ni rje btsun gyis gsungs so/ /bzhi pa phyogs skyong dang 'byung po sogs la gtor ma btang ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /ces pas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma bstan la/ de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma byin/ /zhes pas 'byung po'i gtor ma ston cing / sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang / /zhes pas rigs drug dang / yi dwags kyi gtor ma bstan la/ gnod sbyin srin po kha zas su/ /bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces pas bgegs gtor bstan pa yin no/ /ji ltar btang tshul ni/ dpung bzang nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad do/ /lnga pa dbang la gnyis/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas su/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu brtag /ces pa dang / bdag nyid kyis ni dbang yang blang / /zhes pas bstan te/ rang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa sor tshud par bya ba'i phyir slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba zhig rang nyid kyi bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub tu/

/gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de la yang gnyis te/ 'jug pa dang / dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po 'jug pa la yang gnyis/ sta gon dang / 'jug pa dngos so/ /dang po sta gon la bdun/ yon dbul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ sems bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa/ bsrung ba bya ba'o/ /dang po yon dbul ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas ci 'byor yon yang dbul/ /zhes pas bstan te/ maṇ+ḍal dbul tshul dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gis slob dpon gsol ma btab/ /de ni rigs su skye ba med/ /ces dang / nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab/ /ces gsungs pas gsol ba gdab dgos la/ gzhan phan 'od zer nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang / rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis kha bskangs pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ 'di ni gtsug dgu'i rgyud nas gsungs cing / 'di dang cha 'dra ba gcig rdo rje phreng ba sogs nas kyang 'byung ngo / /gsum pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ 'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub pa/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug ces pas bstan te/ de la yang gsum/ thun mong gi sems bskyed pa/ nang gi sems bskyed pa/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa khas blangs kyi sgo nas bzung ba'o/ /dang po thun mong gi sems bskyed pa ni/ /rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed de/ 'di ni theg pa gong ma gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin pas na de skad ces bya ste/ ngag 'don ni/ dbang med bdag gis zhes sogs nas/ bdag gis gnas par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di ni yo ga'i rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag brgya pa nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa nang gi sems bskyed pa ni/ gsang sngags nang gi lugs/ lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas sems bskyed pa ste zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed do/

/ngag 'don ni/ sa ma ya a zhes pa nas/ tha su kham̐ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni/ ji ltar dus gsum nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa'i bar te/ rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs so/ /bzhi pa byin byis rlabs pa dang / lnga pa smon lam btab pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas byin rlabs byang chub smon lam btab/ /ces pas bstan te/ dang po ni rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum du reg cing byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo spyi gtsug dpung pa gnyis/ /sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna'i rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dmar po kha zlum pa re bsam zhing rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gtug cing / oṃ badz+ra a ti tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ lnga pa smon lam btab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ham̐ zhes brjod de/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bzung la/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba zhes pa nas/ myur du thob par gyur cig zhes pa'i bar ro/ /drug pa zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la zhes pas bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ 'jig rten du ni sogs nas/ 'gyur zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di ni rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud las gsungs so/ /bdun pa bsrung ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ bsrung ba byas nas brtul zhugs sdom pa/ zhes pas bstan te/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs shing / satwa kro dha lan gsum brjod pas bsrung ba'o/ /des sta gon 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ gnyis pa 'jug pa dngos la bcu gsum ste/ yon dbul ba/ gdong bcing ba/ phyag rgya bcings shing nang du gzhug pa/ ye shes dbab pa/ de nyid brtan par bya ba/ me tog dor ba/

de nyid mgo la bcing ba/ gdong g.yogs phye ba/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ dam tshig bskyed pa/ de nyid brtan par bya ba/ sdom pa bsgrag pa/ sdom pa gzung ba dngos so/ /dang po yon dbul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ras la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan te/ a kham̐ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bcing ba'o/ /gsum pa phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal gyis legs par bya/ /zhes dang / me tog rin chen sogs kyis de brgyan te/ /yon gyi lag pa bkang ste gzhug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi ṣiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ gtso bo la sogs pa'i lha so bdun gyi thugs kha nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hūm̐ gi rnam pas char ltar babs pa/ snying kha'i dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge la thim pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag lus dang sems la bde ba dpag tu med par skyes par bsam zhing / rdo rje bsdams pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod pa'o/ /lnga pa de nyid brtan par bya ba ni/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ a sa me sogs brjod/ drug pa me tog dor ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags pa mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis me tog dor bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /nas/ ha na hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis me tog dbul lo/ /bdun pa de nyid mgo la bcing ba ni/ de ltar 'bul ba'i me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas mgo la bcings par bsam zhing / oṃ pra tits+tsha sogs brjod/ brgyad pa gdong g.yogs phye ba ni/

dkyil 'khor sgrib byed kyi dri ma dang gdong g.yogs dus mnyam du bsal bar bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra ha se sogs brjod/ dgu pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya ho/ zhes pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar bsam mo/ /bcu pa dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te de ltar ye shes phab pa'i myong ba dang rtogs pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa rang rgyud la zhugs par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod/ bcu gcig pa de nyid brtan par bya ba ni/ snying kar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da sogs brjod pas brtan par bsam mo/ /bcu gnyis pa sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i zhes sogs nas/ bsrung bar bya zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bcu gsum pa sdom pa gzung ba dngos ni/ khyod kyis srog chags sogs nas/ de bzhin no zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de rnams kyis 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song / gnyis pa bcug nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po spyir bstan pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ sarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ de la yang sarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /zhes tshig rkang gcig gis sngags dbang bstan la/ bum pa la sogs nas/ bskur zhes pa'i bar tshig rkang gnyis kyis dbang bcu bstan te/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang dang gcig rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang la dbu rgyan gyi dbang / dar dpyangs dang phreng ba'i dbang gnyis gcig tu byas te/ rin 'byung la dbang gnyis dang dbang gsum/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang dang / don grub dril bu'i dbang dang gcig tu byas te/

rigs lnga'i phyag rgya'i dbang dang bzhi/ rnam snang ming gi dbang dang lnga/ rdo rje rgya gram byin te las rnam bzhi'i dbang dang drug 'khor lo lag tu byin te slob dpon gyi dbang dang bdun/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi dbang dang brgyad/ dril bu gsung gi dbang dang dgu/ rdo rje thugs kyi dbang dang bcu'o/ /thabs shes rab kyi dbang ni/ de nas rdo rje dril bu lag tu byin/ /zhes rkang pa gcig gis bstan to/ /rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang ni 'khor lo la sogs zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan cing / bka' bsgo ni/ sngags grub phyir ni sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul la brgyad de/ yon dbul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ sngags dbang bskur ba/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / rten de la dam tshig gsum byin pa/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi dbang / de dag gi mtha' rten sbyin pa'o/ /dang po yon dbul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du sogs brjod/ gnyis pa gsol ba btab pa ni/ gzhan phan 'od zer nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang / chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis kha bskangs pa ste/ 'di'i don de nyid 'dus pa nas lhug par gsungs kyang / brjod bde ba'i phyir gur nas gsungs pa'i/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa sngags dbang ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la gus 'dud drag po byas pas lha so bdun gyi thugs kha nas sngags tshan pa bcu gsum po 'di dag gser gyi mdog can du byas te byung / spyi bo nas thim pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag lus dang sems la bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes/ sngags rnams kyi lung thob par bsam zhing / spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ na mo nas/ oṃ bha zhes pa'i bar ro/ /rdo rje slob ma'i dbang la gnyis te/ rig pa'i dbang lnga dang /

de'i mtha' brten las rnam pa bzhi'i dbang ngo / /dang po mi bskyod pa chu dbang ni/ bum pa spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha ka la sha sogs brjod pas zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa lnga dag rnam snang sogs rigs lnga'i byang chub kyi sems/ me long lta bu la sogs pa ye shes lnga'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa rin 'byung gi dbang la gsum/ dang po dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni/ rin po che las byas pa'i rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan mgo la bcings la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs brjod pas nyon mongs pa mtha' dag sbyangs nas rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa phreng ba'i dbang ni/ rin po che sna lnga las byas pa'i me tog phreng ba dbu rgyan gyi rtsa bar bcings la/ oṃ rat+na ma la sogs brjod/ gsum pa dar dpyangs ni/ dar kha dog sna lnga pa lus tshad dang mnyam pa mgo la bcings par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra pa tra sogs brjod/ gsum pa 'og dpag med rdo rje'i dbang dang / bzhi pa don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang stabs gcig tu 'byung ste/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga dang / phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu lag tu byin la/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra sogs brjod pas rigs lnga'i ye shes lnga thob par bsam mo/ /lnga pa rnam snang ming gi dbang ni/ dril bu spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol la/ oṃ bud+dha na ma sogs brjod pas rigs lnga'i ming gi dbang thob par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa las rnam pa bzhi'i dbang ni/ rdo rje rgya gram lag par byin la/ oṃ karma sogs brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag par bsam la/ 'khor lo lag tu byin la/ oṃ tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rum̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis slob ma khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /drug pa de'i mtha' brten du dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i dang po phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ni/

dpon slob gnyis kas rigs lnga'i phyag chen bcas la/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dril bu gsil zhing / oṃ bud+dha tsakra a dhi pa dhi satwam̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs brjod/ gnyis pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig ni/ yum lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / mthar lag pa g.yon du byin la/ oṃ bud+dha dha ra na sogs brjod/ gsum pa rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtug cing / mthar lag pa g.yon g.yas su byin la/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ye sogs brjod/ bdun pa thabs shes zung 'jug gi dbang ni/ rdo rje dril bu bsnol nas byin la/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ /nas/ hūm̐ a zhes pa'i bar ro/ /brgyad pa dbang de dag gi mtha' brten byin pa la gnyis te/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang dang / bka' bsgo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs lag tu byin la/ oṃ tsakra rat+na sogs brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /nas/ 'gyur zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de nas dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa bsrung snyam pas gtso bos sogs dang / dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dbul/ der ma zad lus longs spyod kyi drug cha yang 'bul snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod du gzhug go /drug pa bdag dang gtso bo tha mi dad du bsgrubs te brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas dngos su gsungs shing / shugs bstan gyi dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la'ang mdzad pas/ thog mar rtsa rig dang / lha so so'i sngags tshar re bzla ba ni lha thams cad gsal btab pa'i tshul lo/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dha ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe shar phyogs kyi sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang bdag tha mi dad snyam du bsam/

rat+na dha ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe me tog cher rgyas dang bdag tha mi dad snyam du bsam/ pad+ma dha ra'i dus su nub phyogs pa dang / bi shwa dha ra'i dus su byang phyogs pa dang / ta thā ga ta dha ra'i dus su gtso bo dang bdag tha mi dad snyam du bsam mo/ /de nas gtso bo'i thugs kha nas phyung ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis rang gnas su 'khod par bsam pa ni bdag bsgrub pa'o/ /brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du bzla bya'i sngags rnams bsam la/ lha so so'i sngags brjod pa'i tshe lha de dang de la phog pas de thams cad dbang du 'dus shing brtan par bsam mo/ /bdun pa gshin don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu nyams su blangs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po spyir bstan pa la bcu ste/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba/ dbang bskur te dri'i btsan khang du bcug ste sdig pa sbyang ba/ dbang bskur te mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba/ ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba/ tsha tsha btab ste sdig pa sbyang ba/ sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba/ bzlas pa'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba/ brabs te sdig pa sbyang ba/ ro med na ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang / de thams cad thun mong du phung po chas su 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba ni gong du bstan pa bzhin yin la/ gnyis pa dbang bskur te dri'i btsan khang du bcug ste sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ rang gi lha'am lha gzhan gyi/ /snying po snying khar bris nas ni/ /lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed de/ /khyim gyi dbus su gzhug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan cing / gsum pa mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag cing sbyang ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bskur/ /lha yi gzugs su brtags nas ni/ /mchod rten dbus su bzhag par bya/

/zhes pas bstan pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ro bsregs te sbyang ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni/ /cho ga bzhin du khung brkos la/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /lnga pa tsha tsha btab ste sbyang ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de yi ming nas smos nas su/ /gur gum bzang po'i sngags bris la/ /rim gyi 'bul ni tshang ba dang / /mchod rten las ni rab tu brtag /ces sogs sh+lau ka phyed dang gsum gyis bstan to/ /drug pa sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sbyang ba ni/ yang rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas kyang / /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong nyid du/ /sbyin sreg byas par gyur pa na/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa bzlas te sbyang ba ni/ yang sbyong rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i sngags bzla zhing / /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang / /bye ba nyid du rab bzlas na/ /lha yi gnas su nges par skye/ /zhes pas bstan la/ brgyad pa brabs te sbyang ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ bye ma yungs kar thal ba rnams/ /rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas/ /bzlas pa byas te gtor nas kyang / /rgya mtshor babs pa'i chu klung dor/ /zhes pas bstan cing / dgu pa ro med na ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ yang sbyong rgyud las/ yang na med par gyur na yang / /zlos shing bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /ming tsam legs par bris nas kyang / /mchod rten phreng ba bya ba 'am/ /yang na gzugs su bris kyang rung / /sbyin sreg mngon par dbang bskur na/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /zhes pas bstan pa yin no/ /bcu pa de dag gi thun mong du phung po chas su 'jug pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang / /chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya/ /gos dang rgyan gyis bklubs nas kyang / /sngags kyis btab ste bdug par bya/

/zhes pas bstan to/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nyams su blangs pa'i tshul la don tshan rnam pa bco lngas bstan te/ rten bskyed dgug cing sdig pa bral/ /sbyang ba sbyin sreg bzlas te sbyang / /brab te phyin drug khrus kyis sbyang / /g.yo dang rten pa'i dug kyang sbyang / /bkra shis skyabs 'gro dbang yang bskur/ /de la mchod bstod sbyangs bstan bya/ /zhes bya ste/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ /lho sgo yi ni sa yi char/ /khru gang pa yi tshad du ni/ /stegs bu legs par brtsigs nas kyang / /ba byung lnga yi gci bas byug /ces pas sbyong stegs bstan la/ de'ang rgya dang zabs su khru gang ba'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i steng 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar ṇi'am/ yang na rang gi ming yig dang po klad kor gyis brgyan pa las/ tshe 'das bskyed pa ni slob dpon kun snying gis gsungs so/ /ngan 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa rten dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya yis/ /srid pa bar ma dgug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ phyag rgya dang ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /gsum pa sdig pa bral te rten sbyang rung du bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ shwa dha ni sogs nas/ dri ma med par gyur ces pa'i bar te/ 'di'i sngags rgya gnyis ka shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa sbyang ba la gsum ste/ zhi ba'i sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba/ drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni rdzas sngags gnyis ka zhi ba ste/ de'i phyir na de skad ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni rdzas zhi ba dang sngags drag pos te/ de'i phyir zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni rdzas drag po gu gul nag po/ sngags drag po sum+bha ni ste de'i phyir na drag po'i sbyang ba zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa til gyi sbyang ba ni sbyin sreg gi skabs nas 'byung ba la/ de'i ngag 'don dang bsam bya dkyus bzhin no/

/drug pa bzlas te sbyang ba ni/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag sogs gong bzhin no/ /ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /bdun pa brab pa yang / bye ma yungs dkar sogs kyis bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ nas/ he tu na hūm̐ phaṭ zhes pa'i bar te shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ngo / /brgyad pa khrus kyis sbyang ba ni/ gtsug dgu las/ rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni/ /rdo rje'i chu yis bkru bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de'ang 'das pa'i lha la khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig ni de nyid 'dus par gsungs shing / 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /sogs sh+lau ka gnyis ni dge mtshan bshes gnyen gyi khrus kyi cho gar gsungs so/ /rten la khrus bya ba ni/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin sogs nas/ khrus bya'o zhes pa'i bar ni mdo sde nas 'byung ngo / /dgu pa g.yo ba'i dug sbyang ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang zhes sogs nas/ dug bcom mo zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bcu pa brten pa'i dug sbyang ba ni/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te zhes pa nas/ rlung gi nang du song zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di gnyis ni rma bya chen mo'i mdo las gsungs so/ /bcu gcig pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ gtsug dgu las/ slar yang bkra shis tshigs bcad kyis/ /dus gsum du ni khrus bya 'o/ /zhes pas bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /zhes pa nas sdig par ma gyur cig zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di ni yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /bcu gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zhes pa nas/ bsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar ro/ /'di ni spyod 'jug las gsungs so/ /bcu gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni gong du bstan to/ /bcu bzhi pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ de ltar dbang bskur nas tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpa' gyur pa la/ rgyas par ni 'dod yon lngas mchod cing /
